                var numParticles = data.GetIntegerProperty("num_particles");
                var attributes = data.GetArray("attributes");
                var stringList = data.GetArray<string>("string_list");

                // vpkstuff patch: every attribute array is allocated from num_particles before any
                // is read. Hold the count to what the data can hold, per attribute (float3 12 bytes,
                // skinning 24, the rest 4), and its values to BinaryKV3.MaxValues (a skinning entry
                // builds 9 objects, about 170 bytes, from its 24).
                long bytesPerParticle = 0, valuesPerParticle = 0;
                foreach (var attribute in attributes)
                {
                    var (bytes, values) = attribute.GetStringProperty("type") switch
                    {
                        "float3" or "vector" => (12, 1),
                        "skinning" => (24, 9),
                        _ => (4, 1),
                    };
                    bytesPerParticle += bytes;
                    valuesPerParticle += values;
                }

                if (numParticles < 0 || numParticles > info.Size
                    || numParticles * bytesPerParticle > info.Size
                    || numParticles * valuesPerParticle > ResourceTypes.BinaryKV3.MaxValues)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"Particle snapshot declares {numParticles} particles of {bytesPerParticle} bytes in {info.Size} bytes; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                }
